title: Sitemap, an Information Architecture Tool for Shopify
description: Sitemap is a tool I built to design the information architecture of e-commerce sites, mostly on Shopify. I draw the structure on a visual board, and from the same board I export a FigJam file for the client and an Excel file that SEO and developers use as their starting point.
cardDescription: A tool I built to design site architecture on a visual board and export it to FigJam for clients and to Excel for SEO and Shopify imports.
